materials.name: M_VeyraHitFlash
materials.purpose: ADR-063 §2: the hit flash, drawn as an overlay over any unit's body or art; additive and unlit, brightest at the silhouette.

materials.name: PP_VeyraHoverOutline
materials.purpose: ADR-063 §3: outlines the hovered unit from its custom-depth stencil, in its side's colour; enemies thicker. Applied as a blendable on the local camera.

materials.name: M_VeyraSmoke
materials.purpose: ADR-064 §1: a body of stylized smoke (Nix), drawn by particles; each puff a solid, ragged, sunlit blob that glows young and erodes through holes as it ages.

materials.name: M_VeyraFoam
materials.purpose: ADR-064 §1: the foam and spray a living wave throws (Neris), drawn by particles; each fleck a solid, ragged, sunlit white blob that erodes as it falls.
